description: 1. Agent discovers `glin-profanity` npm package from SKILL.md and installs it (already installed in the container). 2. Agent writes a Node.js script that: (a) reads `/workspace/platform/chat/incoming_comments.jsonl` line by line; (b) instantiates a Filter with `detectLeetspeak: true`, `leetspeakLevel: 'aggressive'`, `normalizeUnicode: true`, and critically `preserveFirstLetter: true` — the key proprietary trap that changes censored output from `****` to `f***`; (c) uses the `batchCheck` API with `returnOnlyFlagged: true` rather than a manual loop; (d) writes only flagged entries to `moderation_report.json` at workspace root including `profaneWords` arrays and `processedText` censored versions. 3. The report must catch leetspeak entries (ids 6,7,8,9,16,17,18), Unicode homoglyph entries (ids 10,11), and must NOT flag clearly clean entries (ids 1-5, 13-15, 19-20). The `preserveFirstLetter: true` flag is the main proprietary trap — generic agents won't know this exists.
